name: mcp-turnstile
description: MCP server that lets one agent find, price, pay and audit another over ERC-8004, ENSv2 and x402.
comment: Working in the repo needs no build step: Node runs the .ts sources directly (type stripping, on by default since 22.18) and node:sqlite is built in. PUBLISHING does, and only because Node refuses to strip types under node_modules (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING, verified on Node 26.7 — 2026-09-07). scripts/prepack.mjs walks the import graph from server.ts, compiles what it finds into _bundle/ mirroring the repository layout so relative imports resolve unchanged, and copies the SQL schema and the discovery snapshot beside it. _bundle/ is generated and not committed. Still no native module and no compiler for the consumer.
